prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Near-photographic cinematic painterly realism for the Korean post-collapse road-trip game Seoul to 400km. Grounded Korean people and infrastructure, restrained cool gray-blue palette, wet or dusty weathered materials, one practical warm amber light source where inhabited, natural anatomy, human-scale action, subtle film grain, believable 35-50mm film-still composition. Match the attached Caravan canonical references exactly in medium, palette, character identity and vehicle design.

Asset type: a transparent live-renderer terrain component, not an event painting and not a screenshot. Generate ONE 16:9 landscape terrain plate at 1536x864 or larger, not a three-screen compressed panorama. It bridges the existing Miryang market outskirts to Daegu outskirts in one screen of lateral landscape. All air above the ridge is truly transparent. The full bottom edge is opaque terrain. No sky, sun, moon, road, caravan, people or text.
Input images 1–4 are canonical style references. Image 5 is a read-only endpoint reference sheet: TOP panel is the exact 1024x576 Miryang terrain; BOTTOM is the exact 1024x576 Daegu terrain. This sheet is not the requested output. Do NOT output stacked panels or duplicate the central market/dome.
COMPOSITION LOCK: use the SAME terrain scale, baseline and atmospheric distance as the two reference panels. For your 1536x864 canvas, the left ridge begins at y=442 (51.2% canvas height), right ridge ends at y=495 (57.3%). Leftmost 96 pixels must continue/reproduce the final 64 pixels of the TOP Miryang panel at proportional 1.5x scale, with its subdued blue-gray mountain, village wall, dark shrubs and agricultural ground textures. Rightmost 96 pixels must continue/reproduce the first 64 pixels of the BOTTOM Daegu panel at proportional 1.5x scale: subdued mountain, tiny weathered urban edge, near dark conifer shapes. Match the reference edge material, exposure and ridge slope, not just a similar color. Keep both sides seamlessly joinable to the actual reference cities WITHOUT vertically stretching or warping any pixel strips.
Between those edge buffers, author a natural low rolling agricultural valley becoming slightly more settled toward the right, coherent continuous distant mountains, small Korean farm roofs, modest worn fields and dark low bushes; no new landmark or large focal object. Landscape must read side-on as an unobtrusive road-movie distance layer. Use the same small-scale crisp-but-painterly foliage/building detail as the reference cities, not blurred, smeared or over-sharpened. Match the reference cool evening-neutral low-contrast grade with only tiny amber inhabited windows; no baked atmospheric curtain. Keep terrain connected naturally, no abrupt high ridge, mirrored repetition, pasted rectangles, alpha holes, blue matte or border halo. Above the connected silhouette all alpha=0; bottommost ground alpha=255 across width. Production component only, no UI or truck. Output a single continuous plate, no collage.
Avoid: anime, manga, comic book, ink outline, cel shading, cartoon, chibi, pixel art, glossy advertising photo, hyperreal skin pores, fashion editorial, studio portrait, 3D render, game-engine screenshot, fantasy, zombies, neon cyberpunk, clean sci-fi vehicle, American RV, panel van, readable text, logo, watermark, UI, frame, collage, split panel
